description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, SharedSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for thread synchronization in the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion via platform-specific critical sections or mutexes.

classes.name: BinarySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore with binary (0 or 1) count, used for synchronization.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that maintains a count, allowing multiple threads to synchronize based on resource availability.

classes.name: SharedSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that can be shared across processes, identified by a name.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A synchronization event object that can be set, reset, and waited upon.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class for RAII-style locking of synchronization objects.
